global_rules.safe_area: STRICTLY apply SafeAreaProvider at the root and SafeAreaView for all screens. No content should render under notches or home indicators.
global_rules.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='continue-button').
global_rules.icons: Use @expo/vector-icons (FontAwesome5, Feather, or Ionicons) for UI adornments. No external image photos needed except the mascot.
global_rules.components: Always use React Native standard views and avoid any html-based rendering. Keep styles inline or via StyleSheet.

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure you load the Fredoka font family (e.g. from @expo-google-fonts/fredoka). Map these scales carefully.

Button3D.description: Duolingo-style gamified button with a thick bottom border simulating 3D depth.
Button3D.interaction: On pressIn, use Animated/Reanimated or state to translate Y by 6px, reduce borderBottomWidth to 0, and maintain the element's total height footprint (e.g. by adding marginTop: 6).

Chip3D.description: Selectable option card/chip with 3D bottom border.
Chip3D.container: borderRadius: 16, padding: 20, marginBottom: 16, backgroundColor: '#222226', borderBottomWidth: 4, borderBottomColor: '#1A1A1D', borderWidth: 2, borderColor: '#222226'
Chip3D.interaction: Pressed state translates Y by 4px, borderBottomWidth drops to 0.

ProgressBar.fill: Absolute positioned view (or Expo LinearGradient if used) from #FF9500 to #FFC000. Height 100%, borderRadius 8. Animate width based on active step index.

Splash.layout: Flex 1, justifyContent 'center', alignItems 'center'. Solid orange background (#FF9500) matching mascot world.
Splash.motion: Fade in on mount. Auto navigate to Welcome after duration.

Welcome.content: Top section: Mascot asset scaled proportionally. Mid section: Welcome Title & Subtitle. Bottom section: Primary 3D Continue button and TOS/Privacy text (muted, small).
Welcome.footer_links: Standard legal links at bottom, color: muted text, textDecorationLine: 'underline'.

OnboardingLayout.header: Row with Back Arrow (left side, width: 40), Progress Bar (center, flex: 1), and a placeholder View (right side, width: 40) for alignment balance.
OnboardingLayout.content: Flex 1, scrollable if content overflows. Title (H1), Subtitle (H3), Dynamic input/chips.
OnboardingLayout.footer: Fixed at bottom above safe area (paddingBottom: 16). Primary 3D Continue button.
